scope: All 19 PDFs in the successful Linux CI artifact: seven actual browser downloads plus twelve bilingual saved-template specimens. All 19 of 19 pages were rendered at 130 DPI and individually visually inspected.
pdfGenerationEnvironment: Linux CI; compiled application uses NODE_ENV=production with isolated AV8_ENV=test for browser acceptance. PDFs were copied byte-for-byte from the downloaded CI artifact, not regenerated locally.
visualReviewEnvironment: Local Poppler 26.10.0 pdfinfo/pdffonts/pdftoppm/pdftotext; manual inspection of every rendered page.
checks: Actual and template contract schedules contain 8/8/2 rows and exact USD 64,000/64,000/54,000 totals with the application fee once.
Calendar-quarter dates and January-31 to April-30 academy settlement remain intact. Visa-triggered rows remain explicitly undated until the event.
Template student statement USD 64,000 = 31,600 paid + 32,400 remaining, with USD 4,100 unapplied and zero refunds separate.
Academy cash-plan obligation USD 54,000, paid zero, remaining USD 54,000 due 2026-04-30.
Actual EN/AR receipt shows USD 2,010 gross less 10 fee = 2,000 net/principal; template receipt shows USD 2,000 less 20 = 1,980. Rates and transaction dates remain distinct.
Actual cleared replacement cheque shows USD 1,000; fee reimbursement shows exactly USD 20 and its actual synthetic recorded signed-copy evidence.
Arabic is joined and readable with RTL labels/columns and intact Latin identifiers, amounts, dates and punctuation.
All pages have readable references/page numbers and no clipped or overlapping rows, missing glyph boxes or detached blank signature pages. Blank signature/stamp spaces do not fabricate signatures.
PDF bytes match the downloaded artifact; exact per-file PDF and render hashes are recorded. Template JSON row arithmetic and English text checks match visible pages.

limitations: All data and signatures/evidence labels are synthetic acceptance fixtures; this review does not approve client legal wording or certify government receipt compliance.
All nineteen artifacts are single-page PDFs. Multi-page pagination is covered by the separate automated 50-row bilingual test; no multi-page visual claim is made here.

The template fixtures deliberately use historical January-end signing anchors that precede their October application-fee fixture date; this is date-arithmetic evidence, not certification of a real chronological student lifecycle.
Actual contract downloads are English; Arabic layout is reviewed in the actual receipt and six Arabic template specimens.
PDF accessibility tagging and perfect bidirectional copy/paste extraction are not certified.
The prior local browser/template review manifests remain historical evidence. Their hashes are not substituted for these Linux CI artifacts.
